title: Add context menu entry in desktop to toggle visibility of all icons (files and folders)
line: The desktop's right-click Icons menu now has a Show Icons checkbox that hides or shows all files and folders on the desktop.
explanation: Hiding the desktop icons was only possible by turning off "Show files and folders" in the desktop settings, which switches the whole desktop to a different containment type. There was no quick toggle in the right-click menu like Windows' View > Show desktop icons. The change adds a checkable "Show Icons" entry at the bottom of the desktop's Icons submenu; unchecking it hides the file view (widgets stay), and the state is saved in the containment config (iconsVisible) so it survives restarts.

commits.message:
containments/desktop: Add a Show Icons toggle to the Icons menu

There was no quick way to hide the files and folders on the desktop: the
only option was turning them off entirely in the desktop settings. Add a
checkable Show Icons entry to the desktop's Icons menu that hides them.

BUG: 495205

media.caption: Desktop right-click > Icons on master: no way to hide the icons from here
Icons submenu now ends with a checked Show Icons entry
After unchecking Show Icons: files and folders are hidden, the widget stays
With icons hidden the menu still opens anywhere and Show Icons is unchecked; checking it brings them back in their old positions
